g.text: Local code graph index for AI coding assistants
Initialize codegraph in any project (interactive wizard)
Start MCP server (for Claude, Cursor, Codex, Gemini)
Stop this repo's owner + worker (alias of serve --stop)
Configure integration for a specific AI tool
What does this function call? (tree view)
Heading tree of a Markdown file
Graph nodes, edges, call stats, storage
Show or switch the graph backend (sqlite/duckdb)
Recent indexing activity grouped by day
CI: blast radius + tests for a PR diff (JSON/md)
List indexed files, or check one (--check)
Health check: verify all components are working
Vacuum SQLite DBs and reclaim space
Install git hooks that reindex after pull/merge/checkout
Add the cgh command to your PATH
Manage extra directories in the graph
Federate sub-repos (parent queries their indexes read-only)
List installed cgh plugins and their status
List / install bundled examples (no git needed)
